adjudication.RUNTIME_CORPUS_DEFECT: none with respect to canonical corpus semantics: the evaluated runtime indexed exactly the canonical ingested dataset snapshot. Secondary runtime pipeline defects are tracked separately (see runtime_defects), not corpus defects
adjudication.V5_BUILDER_SCOPE_DEFECT: true: the builder treated a raw filesystem sources tree (including spider tooling source code and project documents) as the holdout source universe and constructed answer-required cases from material outside the product's citation-eligible evidence universe; no machine corpus-compatibility gate existed to block the formal run before one-shot consumption
adjudication.process_defect: absence of a blinded-safe machine corpus-compatibility preflight (candidate<->runtime snapshot binding + hidden-evidence membership aggregate) allowed an impossible-in-principle formal run to consume the one-shot opportunity

runtime_defects.summary: legacy done payload displayed citations that fail grounding/record resolution (invalid_displayed_citations=63) — violates the RT-101 hard invariant invalid_displayed_citation=0 as product behavior
runtime_defects.fix: display-integrity filter: only grounding-valid (and, when claims exist, display-authorized) citations may be displayed; UNSUPPORTED terminals display zero citations

runtime_defects.summary: generator self-declared no-evidence drafts ('not found' per the product prompt contract) were serialized as answered/cited payloads instead of canonical abstention
runtime_defects.fix: canonical abstain gate: a draft that declares no relevant information (deterministic contract-phrase family), carries no citation markers and is not substantive terminates as canonical UNSUPPORTED with empty citations

runtime_defects.summary: verifier window exhaustion 3/15 (final verifier single-call, no transient retry inside the remaining stage window; provider latency variance)
runtime_defects.fix: bounded single retry for transient empty/parse failures inside the unchanged stage deadline + verifier readiness preflight probe for formal runs; no deadline extension, no verifier skip
